summary: BioAge Labs filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that the first participant has been dosed in QUELL-DME, a randomized, controlled, three-arm Phase 2 trial of once-daily oral BGE-102, an NLRP3 inhibitor, in adults with diabetic macular edema. Roughly 180 participants are randomized 1:1:1 across anti-VEGF plus placebo, anti-VEGF plus BGE-102 90 mg daily, and sham injection plus BGE-102 90 mg daily, over 12 weeks of dosing with four-week follow-up. Primary endpoint is week-12 best-corrected visual acuity change; topline results are expected in the second half of 2027. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are stated.
